en: A colorized postcard-style illustration of a small red-brick railway station building set in a green, grassy landscape with trees around it. The building has a steep metal roof, arched windows, and a sign on the facade reading "HARDEBERGA." At the top left of the image, printed text reads "Järnvägsstationen, Hardeberga." The sky is blue with scattered clouds, and the overall style suggests an early 20th‑century depiction.
